scope: CPU-only fixture and forecast validity review for one seed44 cap1024-to-2048 extension. No launch, device work, or score/stage adjudication.

fixture_checks.finding: Candidate prompt IDs, chosen continuation, sampling (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20), and seed 44 exactly match source fixture. Candidate metadata cites verified source fixture/result/coordinator hashes and changes only cap 1024→2048. Manifest has branches=[], one free-running trial, 2048-token cap.

forecast.formula: Observed source diagnostic prefill/host overhead plus observed decode wall scaled by 2047/1023; add same-mode measured load and explicit first-TF preparation allowance. Range scales variable case work by 0.7x–1.7x, fixed load and preparation unchanged.
forecast.allowance_note: The first-preparation allowance is the prior full-mode first chosen-64 teacher-forcing branch duration, used as a conservative proxy; it is not a measured cap2048 warmup.
forecast.arithmetic: Recomputed all totals and interval endpoints from source diagnostic measurements; after documenting 0.7x–1.7x multipliers, arithmetic matches.

limitations: No output semantic review because candidate has not run.
This review does not admit the candidate or sign off the stage.
